website_online.description: Deploy the existing API qualification website and make the configured domain reachable over HTTPS.

notes: The worker must reject unknown task types.
The worker must reject forbidden payload fields.
Task text is generated locally from trusted templates, not accepted as arbitrary remote instructions.
Secrets may only be used locally by reference and must never be written back to GitHub.
The GitHub payload cannot supply or override the local secret source. local_sensitive_workbook is a reference only, never a credential value.
